statement: Mixed arity-six PD bar indecomposables have an exact order-two H7 class, refuting a unary prime-power description
depends_on: D029; C24 integral signed-Lyndon basis; explicit matrix D-Q6
notes: For P=Za+Zb, multidegree a^2b^4 has H7=Z/2 and no other cohomology. Does not assert a nonzero actual target-map obstruction.
